data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: ShareX
data_tooling.summary: ShareX 是一款免费开源的屏幕截图与文件分享工具，核心优势在于高度可定制的工作流：支持自定义快捷键、80余个上传目标（如Imgur、Dropbox），并自动执行OCR识别、水印添加等后处理操作。基于C#开发，轻量且功能强大，可通过插件扩展或集成至自动化脚本，是商业工具的绝佳替代。适合需高效视觉沟通的开发者、设计师及普通用户，尤其适用于频繁截图并需快速分享或归档的场景。
data_tooling.summary_en: ShareX is a free, open-source screen capture and file sharing tool that streamlines capturing, annotating, and uploading screenshots or recordings. Its key strength lies in its extensive customization: users can define workflows with custom hotkeys, choose from over 80 upload destinations (e.g., Imgur, Dropbox), and apply post-capture actions like OCR or image effects. Built in C#, it offers a lightweight yet powerful alternative to proprietary tools. Developers can extend its functionality via plugins or integrate it into automation pipelines. Ideal for developers, designers, and anyone needing efficient visual communication.

ui_devex.name: spec-kit
ui_devex.summary: Spec-kit 是一个用于规范驱动开发的 Python 工具包，帮助团队在编码前就规范达成一致。它提供模板与工作流，支持规范的协作定义、审查与迭代，减少误解和返工。核心理念是将规范视为随项目演进的活文档，而非静态需求。用户可起草新功能规范、收集团队反馈，再按共享蓝图编码，尤其适合与 Copilot 等AI工具结合。通过紧密衔接规范与开发，spec-kit 提升协作效率，确保目标统一，是实践规范驱动开发的实用起点。
ui_devex.summary_en: Spec-kit is a Python toolkit for spec-driven development, helping teams align on clear specifications before writing code. It provides templates and workflows to define, review, and iterate on specs collaboratively, reducing misunderstandings and rework. The key insight is treating specs as living documents that evolve with the project, not static requirements. Use it to kickstart new features by drafting a spec, getting team feedback, and then coding against a shared blueprint—ideal for AI-assisted development with Copilot or similar tools.

agents_workflows.summary: ShareX 是一款免费开源的屏幕截图与文件分享工具，核心优势在于高度可定制的工作流：支持自定义快捷键、80余个上传目标（如Imgur、Dropbox），并自动执行OCR识别、水印添加等后处理操作。基于C#开发，轻量且功能强大，可通过插件扩展或集成至自动化脚本，是商业工具的绝佳替代。适合需高效视觉沟通的开发者、设计师及普通用户，尤其适用于频繁截图并需快速分享或归档的场景。
agents_workflows.summary_en: ShareX is a free, open-source screen capture and file sharing tool that streamlines capturing, annotating, and uploading screenshots or recordings. Its key strength lies in its extensive customization: users can define workflows with custom hotkeys, choose from over 80 upload destinations (e.g., Imgur, Dropbox), and apply post-capture actions like OCR or image effects. Built in C#, it offers a lightweight yet powerful alternative to proprietary tools. Developers can extend its functionality via plugins or integrate it into automation pipelines. Ideal for developers, designers, and anyone needing efficient visual communication.

framework_core.name: spec-kit
framework_core.summary: Spec-kit 是一个用于规范驱动开发的 Python 工具包，帮助团队在编码前就规范达成一致。它提供模板与工作流，支持规范的协作定义、审查与迭代，减少误解和返工。核心理念是将规范视为随项目演进的活文档，而非静态需求。用户可起草新功能规范、收集团队反馈，再按共享蓝图编码，尤其适合与 Copilot 等AI工具结合。通过紧密衔接规范与开发，spec-kit 提升协作效率，确保目标统一，是实践规范驱动开发的实用起点。
framework_core.summary_en: Spec-kit is a Python toolkit for spec-driven development, helping teams align on clear specifications before writing code. It provides templates and workflows to define, review, and iterate on specs collaboratively, reducing misunderstandings and rework. The key insight is treating specs as living documents that evolve with the project, not static requirements. Use it to kickstart new features by drafting a spec, getting team feedback, and then coding against a shared blueprint—ideal for AI-assisted development with Copilot or similar tools.
